name: zdev
description: zOne feature development: plan a feature with you against the real code on Opus (read-only investigation, impact analysis, open questions, a reviewed plan) save the confirmed plan to the D: drive folder Claude Implementation Plans, and build it after you approve, in this session or a fresh session on Sonnet or Opus (/zdev:plan); draft a Technical Requirement Document with you from your docs and the code, revise it until you accept, and export a styled DOCX (/zdev:new-trd); add a new Custom Report data source as SQL migrations (/zdev:new-report); create or update the pull request with the right target branch, linked bugs and tasks, a clean title and description and a Depended PR tag when needed (/zdev:pr)
